chunks: And in the narration of Ibn Bukayr:
that al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,
"And upon those who can fast with difficulty, there is a ransom: the feeding of a poor person."
He said: "It applies to those who were able to fast, then old age, chronic thirst, or something similar afflicted them; so upon them is a mudd for each day."

key_terms.طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ: feeding of a poor person as expiation
key_terms.فِدْيَةٌ: compensation given in place of fasting
key_terms.مُدٌّ: a prescribed measure of food given for each day
key_terms.يُطِيقُونَهُ: are able to bear it with hardship

ai.seo_question: Who does the verse about feeding a poor person instead of fasting apply to?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains that this verse concerns people who were once able to fast but later became unable due to old age, chronic thirst, or similar conditions. Instead of fasting, they must give a mudd of food for each day. The report clarifies the legal application of the verse in cases of enduring hardship.
